_about: Milestones for tools/plan.py. Each milestone is done when its exit condition is met, not when its features are checked off. Weights are effort shares (judgement).

milestones.title: Clean meshes: open, fit, measure, over CLI and MCP
milestones.exit: Logan downloads an STL from a model-sharing site, asks Claude over MCP for its hole diameters and face distances, and they match the design dimensions.

milestones.title: Mesh to editable CAD through SolidCraft
milestones.exit: A simple prismatic downloaded part is rebuilt as a SolidCraft model whose deviation from the STL is under 0.05 mm.

milestones.title: Noisy scans: robust fits, deviation, alignment, thickness
milestones.exit: A real scan (a public sample scan or a phone scan) gives stable fits and a deviation report against its CAD.

milestones.title: Reverse-engineering workflows with AI
milestones.exit: Claude proposes a feature tree (holes, patterns, symmetry) for a part and Logan accepts it in SolidCraft.

milestones.title: Reusable engine
milestones.exit: Another project depends on rulercraft-mesh from crates.io or git, and the engine builds for Wasm and runs the app in a browser with nothing to install.

milestones.title: Photos to mesh (research)
milestones.exit: A written go/no-go with a prototype on photos of one object.

milestones.title: v1: the native app for the SolidCraft community, at parity and beyond
milestones.exit: A SolidCraft user (Logan standing in until others try it) does all four jobs of docs/v1.md on their own parts in the native app without help: inspect with a dimensioned report and a deviation check, rebuild a part in SolidCraft, let Claude measure while they watch, and use the engine from another program.
